articles.title: Russia Hacked Routers to Steal Microsoft Office Tokens
articles.summary: Microsoft patches a staggering 167 vulns including a SharePoint zero-day and 'BlueHammer' in Windows Defender, while Chrome fixes its fourth zero-day this year. April showers bring May flowers, but Patch Tuesday brings existential dread.

articles.title: Meta U-turns on encryption push for Instagram as DMs go plaintext
articles.summary: The 'Dirty Frag' Linux flaw delivers root access with no CVE and public exploits after a broken disclosure embargo. When responsible disclosure goes wrong, admins get pwned.

articles.title: Dirty Frag: a zero-day universal Linux LPE
articles.summary: Nation-state actors exploited Palo Alto PAN-OS zero-day CVE-2026-0300 for weeks, gaining root on firewalls and covering their tracks. Your security appliance just became their playground.

articles.title: Anti-DDoS Firm Heaped Attacks on Brazilian ISPs
articles.summary: Canvas gets ransomed by cybercriminals who defaced login pages nationwide, disrupting schools and colleges. ShinyHunters strikes again—because apparently education wasn't suffering enough already.

articles.title: Congress Narrowed the GUARD Act, But Serious Problems Remain
articles.summary: Russian military intelligence mass-harvested Microsoft Office tokens by exploiting old router flaws in a sophisticated supply chain attack. Your ancient Linksys just became Moscow's best friend.

articles.title: Hackers ate my homework: Educational SaaS Canvas down after cyberattack
articles.summary: Meta abandons end-to-end encryption for Instagram DMs, going full plaintext after years of privacy promises. Zuck's surveillance capitalism shows its true colors once again.

articles.title: Free Signal Guide
articles.summary: Congress narrowed the GUARD Act after criticism, but it still threatens AI system access with dangerous age verification schemes. Because nothing says 'protecting kids' like destroying privacy for everyone.

articles.title: Milestone 1.0.0 Release of APK Downloader `apkeep` Powers Research on Android Apps
articles.summary: EFF releases free Signal guide in English and Spanish to help preserve privacy and security. Because in 2026, using encrypted messaging shouldn't require a PhD in cryptography.

articles.title: ShinyHunters Claims Second Attack Against Instructure
articles.summary: The federal SECURE Data Act is privacy theater from House Republicans—a retreat from existing protections disguised as consumer protection. Corporate surveillance gets a Congressional hall pass.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, April 2026 Edition
articles.summary: Scattered Spider's 'Tylerb' pleads guilty to wire fraud and identity theft after SMS phishing campaigns in 2022. Another young hacker learns that cybercrime doesn't pay—at least not when you get caught.
